# Attribution

The cases under `spec/`, `extensions/` and `regression/` are the examples of three files in the
repository of cmark-gfm, <https://github.com/github/cmark-gfm>, at the tag `0.29.0.gfm.13`. Each
example's input is one file, numbered in the order the source file holds them, with each `→` the
source writes for a tab turned into a tab. The `.xml` beside each is that version of cmark-gfm's
parse of it. Nothing else is changed.
